# Data present
- `go_id_names_aspects.csv`: For each human Gene Ontology annotation, the full name and aspect (BP, MF, CC). Output from `~/ch5_integration/5.2 cellular_component_localisation/go_tree_extraction.R`.

# Data absent
(due to file size)
- `goa_human.gaf.gz`: Gene Ontology annotations for humans, from version 2025-06-01, downloaded 20 June, 2025.
- `go.obo`: Gene Ontology ontology tree from version 2025-06-01, downloaded 20 June, 2025.
- `go_id_ancestor_relations.csv`: Listing all ancestors for any given human Gene Ontology annotation. The annotation itself is included as an ancestor. Output from `~/ch5_integration/5.2 cellular_component_localisation/go_tree_extraction.R`.
